units.reason: Pure rename of unexported marker type allStaleSeriesPostings; its construction and type-switch use are both updated in this PR.
units.headline: Marker type allStaleSeriesPostings renamed to allSelectedSeriesPostings
units.summary: The unexported postings marker type is renamed with the same embedded index.Postings shape. Both the producer (Postings) and the consumer (SortedPostings type switch) use the new name, so behavior is identical and a line-by-line review can be skipped.

units.reason: Receiver, field and local variable renamed only (headStaleIndexReader to headSelectedSeriesIndexReader, staleSeriesRefs to selectedSeriesRefs); logic unchanged.
units.headline: Postings method moved to renamed headSelectedSeriesIndexReader type
units.summary: Same logic as before: empty postings for no refs, the marker postings for AllPostingsKey, otherwise an intersection with head postings. Only unexported type, field and variable names and a comment changed, so the behavior is the same.

units.reason: Only the unexported receiver type, field name and comment text changed; the intersection logic is identical.
units.headline: PostingsForLabelMatching moved to renamed selected-series index reader
units.summary: The method still intersects the precomputed ref list with the head's label-matching postings. Only the unexported receiver type, field name and comment wording changed, so the behavior is the same.

units.reason: Only the unexported receiver type, field name and comment text changed; the intersection logic is identical.
units.headline: PostingsForAllLabelValues moved to renamed selected-series index reader

units.reason: Code moved from removed headStaleIndexReader.SortedPostings with unexported type, marker and field renames only; the switch logic is identical.
units.headline: SortedPostings moved to renamed reader, matching on renamed marker type
units.summary: The removed headStaleIndexReader.SortedPostings is re-added under the new receiver. It still returns the pre-sorted-by-labels refs for the marker type and otherwise falls back to headIndexReader.SortedPostings. The doc comment still names the old headStaleIndexReader.Postings(), but that does not affect behavior.

units.reason: New test-only code exercising filterSeriesAndSortPostings; it cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: New test for filterSeriesAndSortPostings keep, OOO-skip and missing-ref cases
units.summary: Adds a test that appends one clean series, one series with an out-of-order sample and a bogus ref. It checks that only the clean series is returned by filterSeriesAndSortPostings with isSeriesWithoutOOO. It only adds coverage and changes no existing expectations.
